messages:
nina: Quick sync - Marketing wants to run a pricing-page experiment next sprint: add an inline estimator widget, rename tiers, and tweak the FAQ copy for clarity. Aim: reduce high-touch sales asks and boost self-serve conversions. Who can own what? omar: I can own the tracker spec and the analytics naming. Need names for events and the data schema for the routing webhook. shaun: I'll take the calculator front-end embed and QA. Do we have a design variant for a non-modal inline widget vs modal? maria: We have two variants in Figma: inline tile and modal drawer. For the A/B we want inline only vs baseline. Design will publish frames by EOD. gabi: Sales input: routing criteria should be: any estimated_monthly_cost >= 5000 USD -> AE route; if visitor checks "Private/On-prem" option -> enterprise team. Otherwise default to marketing nurture. Also would love a categorical field 'estimated_segment' (self-serve / mid-market / enterprise). omar: Noted. Proposed analytics events: pricing_widget_open, pricing_widget_submit, pricing_widget_result_usd, pricing_contact_cta_click. Payloads will include estimated_monthly_usd, tier_selected, and utm params. shaun: Embed snippet prototype: ```html
``` Will make it preload-friendly. nina: Copy: Tier naming option 1 = Starter / Pro / Enterprise. Option 2 = Essentials / Performance / Enterprise. Which lands better with product? maria: Product prefers Pro over Performance. Use Starter / Pro / Enterprise for experiment. gabi: Legal: don't promise performance or uptime on public page. Use "Enterprise plans include premium SLAs" instead of blanket SLA language. omar: For event names we should prefix with "rw_" to avoid GA collisions: rw_pricing_widget_open, rw_pricing_result_usd, rw_pricing_contact_click. Also include user_anonymous_id if available. shaun: Timeline: devs can get widget into staging by Tue, tests Wed, and rollout to experiment Thursday. Can marketing confirm copy & CTAs by Monday morning? nina: I'll finalize FAQ edits and CTA language. Suggest changing primary CTA text to 'See an estimate' for the experiment variant (baseline stays 'Get started'). gabi: Sales confirms webhook fields and will subscribe to the webhook for AE queuing. Also request a 1x daily CSV drop for MQLs during the test window. maria: Benchmarks: include a short narrative for the launch post referencing the experiment outcomes we hope for (reduced Contact Sales by 10-20%, self-serve signups +8%). We'll also run a webinar two weeks after launch to show cost-savings patterns for early adopters. omar: I'll add the event -> BigQuery mapping and the GA4 config. Also will create an alert if pricing_contact_click increases unexpectedly. shaun: Deploy bot: PR opened to staging: https://github.com/redwood-inference/front-end/pull/1987 by shaun deploy-bot: Staging build available: https://staging.redwood.ai/pricing-experiment (build-2026-09-14-113) nina: Great. Running experiment for 21 days. Marketing will track signup conversion lift and contact-sales delta. Webinar planning: @maria can you own scheduling? maria: Yep - I'll set the webinar invite for week 3, coordinate with sales and product for demos. Will draft the benchmark narrative and send to this thread for review. gabi: I'll monitor leads and surface any high-value prospects to AE. shaun: Will post the final staging link and QA checklist when ready. maria: Thanks team. Ping me for clarifications. We'll reconvene after the first week of data. :rocket:
